'''Tigraine Mantear''' (pronounced: tee-GRAIN), was the only daughter of Queen [[Mordrellen Mantear]] of [[Andor]]. She is the mother of [[Galad Damodred]] and [[Rand al'Thor]].

==Appearance==
Like many of the Andoran royal line, she had red hair. Elayne notes that Rand looks like pictures she had seen of Tigraine.{{ref/book|3|29}} Later, [[Dyelin Taravin]] makes the same observation and asks Rand directly about his parentage.{{ref/book|6|16}}

== History ==
Tigraine was born in {{ne|950}} and was the [[Daughter-Heir]] of Andor. 

In {{ne|954}} her only brother, [[Luc Mantear]] was born. He would become her [[First Prince of the Sword]] when she was a few years old.

Even though she had no ability to channel, she studied in the [[White Tower]] from 966-{{ne|967}}, and by tradition between [[Andor]] and the White Tower, she was awarded the [[Great Serpent ring]].

After returning to [[Caemlyn]], she married [[Taringail Damodred]], whom she never loved, to help relations between Andor and [[Cairhien]]. They had a son, [[Galadedrid Damodred]], in {{ne|970}}. She was told by the [[Aes Sedai]] [[Gitara Moroso]] to become a [[Maiden of the Spear]] or the world would suffer.{{ref/book|4|34}}{{ref|[[Foretelling]]}} Tigraine vanished mysteriously from Caemlyn in [[972 NE]], never to be heard from again, causing the [[Succession Wars#Third Succession War|third Succession War]]. She travelled into the [[Aiel Waste]], where she  became a ''[[Far Dareis Mai]]'' within a year despite of the lack of Aiel origins. She never told her real name or her explicit origin to the Aiel. They only knew her by her chosen name '''Shaiel''', meaning "Woman Who Is Dedicated" in the [[Old Tongue]]. She spoke about a child abandoned whom she loved and a husband she did not, and the [[Foretelling#Tigraine Mantear|prophecy of Gitara Moroso]]. 

[[File:Tigraine CLT.png|thumb|Tigraine as Shaiel by Chad L. Trent|left]]She was adopted into the [[Chumai]] Sept of the [[Taardad]] [[Aiel]] and fell in love with the clan chief, [[Janduin]]. They travelled with the [[Taardad]] over the [[Dragonwall]] to execute King [[Laman Damodred]], the Oathbreaker, for his crime against the Tree. In the third year of the Aiel War, she became pregnant by Janduin. She should have been sent home, but was not,{{ref/book|4|34}} and gave birth to her child on the slope of Dragonmount on the third day of the [[Battle of the Shining Walls]], the last day of Nesan, {{Ne|978}} and died moments later. This was a child of the prophecy of the Dragon Reborn, [[Rand al'Thor]].

==Parallels==
Tigraine is a reference in both name and role to [[Wikipedia:Igraine|Igraine]], a character out of Arthurian legend. Igraine was the mother of King Arthur by a man other than her husband, similar to how Tigraine bears Rand al'Thor.{{ref/book|origins|Tigraine Mantear}}

== In the television series ==
In the television series, {{TVlink|Tigraine Mantear}} was played by {{TVlink|Magdalena Sittova}}
